content:
VZMORE has a Black Friday 2026 sale for the 16-core/22-thread Intel Core Ultra 185H-powered iX9 Max mini PC, which follows a similar promotion for the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470-based AX9 Max mini PC earlier this month (still ongoing). The mini PC comes with 24 GB of LPDDR5-5600 memory and a 1 TB NVMe SSD. It supports up to four simultaneous displays via HDMI 2.0 and USB4 ports, offers six USB Type-A ports, two 40 Gbps USB4 ports, and two 2.5 GbE ports, as well as Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 wireless connectivity. It’s now available for $797.16 ($151.84 OFF) with the coupon code IX9CNXBFOFF. VZMORE iX9 Max specifications: SoC – Intel Core Ultra 9 185H CPU – 16-core (6P+8E+2LPE)/22-thread Meteor Lake-H processor @ up to 5.1 GHz with 24 MB cache GPU – Intel Arc graphics AI accelerator – Intel AI Boost NPU up to 11 TOPS (INT8); [...]
